intent: To inform viewers about the rate of college diploma attainment among adults in Israel.

units.meaning: The college-diploma attainment rate among adults over 25 is about 47%.

basis.note: Table's printed share value is 47 percent.

accepted_routes: About 47% of adults over 25 have a college diploma.
The college-diploma attainment rate for people aged 25+ is roughly 47%.
Roughly 47 out of every 100 over-25s hold a college diploma.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The central donut share or label must show 47% for college-diploma attainment, with the over-25 population qualifier present in narration/on-screen text.
units.temporal_anchor: The main clause stating 'About 47% of those over 25 have a college diploma.'
units.reviewer_question: Should the 47% college-diploma share among over-25s be treated as the required central claim?

optional_valid: The chart is a single-share donut, so the video need not show a trend or ranking.
The value is approximately 47%, allowing rounded phrasing such as 'about 47%'.
If visually useful, the 47% can be described as close to but below half, without saying it is exactly half.
unsupported_to_avoid: Do not claim 47% of all Israelis or all adults have a college diploma; the narration specifies over 25.
Do not invent trend, causal, or demographic breakdowns not present in the table.
Do not treat 53% as a table value; it is only a derived complement.
Do not claim 47% is exactly half or a majority.
Do not use counts of people unless a population total is provided.
notes: The table has only one printed share: 47%, with relative_value 0.4700. The main required content is the 47% rate plus the over-25/Israel scope; complements and threshold framings are valid but optional.
file_naming: one G1 per input contract; B1/B3/B4/B5 need separate drafts
narration_use: reference only when drafting; required units must be derivable from the public B2 inputs (table + intent)
weight_mode_note: every unit gets 1/n so coverage is a plain share; weight_template is kept for per-type analysis only
